App icon concepts

Five names and icons for the native JS8 client. Icons are opaque 1024 px PNGs (iOS masks the corners; the rounded previews here imitate that). Full name list and conflict notes: NAMES.md.

Eightfold

Recommended

JS8 is 8-tone FSK. A single glowing figure-8 with a signal pulse riding the loop; owns the "8" without borrowing the JS8Call name.

dark
light

Undernoise

Runner-up

JS8 decodes around −24 dB SNR, below the noise floor. A jagged noise floor on top, the clean JS8 tone staircase gliding underneath it.

dark
light

Costas

Every JS8 frame starts with a 7×7 Costas array (4 2 5 6 1 3 0) for sync. This is that exact pattern, lit up; the most legible icon at 60 px.

dark
light

Tonestep

The 8 FSK tones as a staircase climbing the waterfall lanes, transmitting from the top step.

Pocket JS8

Descriptive

A chat bubble with the tone staircase cut into it and radio waves off the corner: keyboard-to-keyboard chat over HF. The safe descriptive option.
